authority: docs/rocky-next-concept.md plus orchestrator prompt and Taskbot epic 1

requirements.required_behavior: One supported Attraccess workflow and harness, one active implementation, typed deterministic transitions; agents do engineering judgment.
requirements.required_evidence: Local backend and UI coding cases plus run timeline show software-owned setup/checks/publication.

requirements.required_behavior: Durable issue-event deduplication, clarification distinct from approval, explicit steering/scope revisions, cancellation and issue ownership.
requirements.required_evidence: Duplicate/steered/cancelled events produce one accountable run and no conflicting coordinator owner.

requirements.required_behavior: Before expensive work validate credentials, disk/capacity, supported repository, fixtures/hardware, effective configuration and executing release.
requirements.required_evidence: Admission matrix names missing prerequisite and records every rejection; no unsupported task edits start.

requirements.required_behavior: Version behavior, exclusions, affected surfaces, fixture IDs, evidence and delivery mode; freeze base SHA and run smoke baseline.
requirements.required_evidence: Pre-existing failure stays distinct from introduced defect; changed scope invalidates dependent decisions.

requirements.required_behavior: Task-owned isolated workspace records base/head/instruction digests and preserves unpublished changes; no old branch overwrite.
requirements.required_evidence: Workspace ownership, safe teardown and unpublished-work retention receipts.

requirements.required_behavior: Verify repository-pinned toolchain and lockfile; successful repository bootstrap receipt; fail unsupported script/instruction/config drift.
requirements.required_evidence: Actual binary identities, bootstrap output and injected drift rejection.

requirements.required_behavior: Frozen affected-project comparison resolves all applicable core/e2e/plugin packaging/firmware/guard checks from authoritative repository metadata.
requirements.required_evidence: Check plan covers actual CI obligations; no agent can suppress required checks.

requirements.required_behavior: Generate API client when relevant without committing generated client or repository-prohibited plans/specs; plans live in run store.
requirements.required_evidence: Required generation receipt and final target diff show policy compliance.

requirements.required_behavior: Own database/storage/migrations/seeds/processes; consume authoritative ports and verify actual frontend/API; ten clean setup/test/teardown cycles.
requirements.required_evidence: All cycle artifacts, data isolation, ownership and zero leaked/cross-contaminated services/ports.

requirements.required_behavior: Independent fresh install/admin/member/denied/resource-group/unenrolled-2FA/plugin enabled-disabled fixtures; accounts and authentication data private.
requirements.required_evidence: Fresh installation never reuses initialized DB; one-time state is not shared; actual plugin installed.

requirements.required_behavior: Pinned deterministic browser scenarios assert behavior and save/reload persistence; EN/DE and desktop/mobile coverage per changed surface; retain traces/screenshots.
requirements.required_evidence: Script assertions and artifacts bound to head/scenario/fixture/role/locale/viewport.

requirements.required_behavior: Separate fixture/environment/product failure; login/session failures are product when under test; label simulated/compiled/physical evidence and require physical availability if mandatory.
requirements.required_evidence: Adversarial fixture and device-capability cases yield accurate named outcomes, never HTTP-only proof.

requirements.required_behavior: One harness with typed results, explicit completion of pending tools, owned resumable sessions, model/effort identity and cancellation.
requirements.required_evidence: Incomplete, malformed, failed and cancelled sessions cannot authorize delivery.

requirements.required_behavior: Independent acceptance and bounded code/subjective UX review; new tests fail old behavior when applicable; implementation cannot weaken protected scenarios.
requirements.required_evidence: Evaluator manifest unchanged; old/new behavior evidence and stable findings/resolutions.

requirements.required_behavior: Local checks precede expensive review; CI collection and repair allowance independent of review; bound no-op/repeated signatures and one disagreement arbitration.
requirements.required_evidence: Failed CI reaches repair after review exhaustion; unchanged findings stop without raising limits.

requirements.required_behavior: Local receipt binds head/tree/base/command/toolchain/status/log; browser binds scenario/fixture/role/locale/viewport; review binds head/scope/findings; approval binds approver/head/scope/action.
requirements.required_evidence: Mutation of a relevant identity makes the old receipt stale; agents receive authoritative receipts directly.

requirements.required_behavior: Immutable artifact manifests and bounded full logs with partial timeout output; retain diagnostic excerpts and explicit missing-artifact/log gaps.
requirements.required_evidence: Hash mismatch or missing artifact cannot become pass; command timeout retains pre-timeout output.

requirements.required_behavior: Observe real workflow/job/attempt and required checks; distinguish PR head and synthetic integration/merge-group SHA and superseding attempts.
requirements.required_evidence: Current remote CI identities/protection state and missing-log failure receipts.

requirements.required_behavior: Code changes invalidate relevant checks/reviews; fixture/scenario changes stale browser evidence; live service readiness differs from historical verification; reporting retry may reuse valid evidence.
requirements.required_evidence: Changed-head/fixture tests and CI polling after deliberate service stop do not fabricate readiness or erase historical pass.

requirements.required_behavior: Transactional stage/input identity, append-only events and fenced single owner; sessions are not run authority.
requirements.required_evidence: Rollback/crash, competing claimant and stale-owner mutations preserve one valid committed state.

requirements.required_behavior: Commit intent before external write; stable operation identity and payload; persist confirmed receipt; lost response requires reconciliation before repeat.
requirements.required_evidence: Crash windows and duplicate transport demonstrate one remote object or explicit unresolved reconciliation, never claimed exactly-once.

requirements.required_behavior: Owned process groups, bounded command deadlines/logs, cancellation stopping owned descendants only; recover/inspect lost workers.
requirements.required_evidence: Timeout/cancel/orphan cases preserve logs, remove owned processes and leave unrelated sentinel alive.

requirements.required_behavior: External waits back off with deadline/next wake and release execution capacity; cancellation blocks new effects while reconciling sent effects; cleanup preserves evidence and unpublished work.
requirements.required_evidence: Waiting/cancelled/recovery states and bounded resource retention are observable.

requirements.required_behavior: Record workflow/adapter/prompt/runner/build versions; no silent in-flight upgrade; compatible resume, drain or explicit tested migration.
requirements.required_evidence: Old run under incompatible build stops before effects and retains original identities.

requirements.required_behavior: Artifact-derived concise change/acceptance/screenshots/limitations/PR package; report outage stays pending without rerunning engineering; no-code outcome separately verified and excluded from coding metric.
requirements.required_evidence: PR report/publication receipts and no-code denominator exclusion.

requirements.required_behavior: Revision/scope/action-bound human approval, revocation and changed-head invalidation; actual protections/merge queue honored.
requirements.required_evidence: Stale approval rejected; ready-for-review, merge-requested and merged are separate verified states.

requirements.required_behavior: Coordinator-owned tracker effects with durable receipts; confirm Linear state independently from merge; publication failures do not replay code.
requirements.required_evidence: Merged-but-closeout-pending failure and reconciled tracker receipt.

requirements.required_behavior: One validated effective config with provenance; operator credential references/bot identity/capacity/budgets/delivery/notifications distinct from maintainer policy; secrets separated and ingress minimal.
requirements.required_evidence: Invalid config rejected; provenance visible; secret redaction and tool/ingress authorization tests.

requirements.required_behavior: Queue/Run/Evidence/Decision/Operations answer change, verification, blocker and next action; linked raw transcripts, read-only workflow, elapsed/cost/disk/versions/worker health.
requirements.required_evidence: Real-browser essential-state verification includes blocked/stale/waiting/report-pending and stopped daemon.

requirements.required_behavior: Clean installable committed artifact embeds source/build identity; tested artifact matches running verification instance; documented install/operation.
requirements.required_evidence: Clean package/install smoke and health identity comparison; foundation smoke alone is not installed live acceptance.

requirements.required_behavior: Measure disk/process/browser capacity, waits and cleanup; one implementation initially; contention preserves ownership.
requirements.required_evidence: Resource and competing-worker tests, no lost unpublished work; expansion only after evidence gate.

requirements.required_behavior: Freeze ten real eligible coding tasks before scored trials; >=8 verified PR handoffs without operator repair; report every admission rejection/attempt/failure/intervention and missing artifact.
requirements.required_evidence: Immutable corpus/base/fixture/model/budget identities plus complete denominator and outcomes.

requirements.required_behavior: Every mandatory adversarial case passes without relaxing criteria; all failures accurately classified.
requirements.required_evidence: Individual retained scenario receipts for A01-A14, not an aggregate assertion.

requirements.required_behavior: Archive selected old source/PR/profile/run/failure evidence without credentials; preserve unfinished branches/PRs; no old runtime restart/import by default.
requirements.required_evidence: Reference inventory and secret-safe retention evidence; explicit import rereads branch/PR and invalidates unproven receipts.

requirements.required_behavior: Narrow internal repository/tracker/runner/effect interfaces; no public workflow SDK/editor/arbitrary repository or multiple harness delivery in v1.
requirements.required_evidence: Module ownership and same acceptance corpus; deferred capabilities visibly listed.

requirements.required_behavior: Independent review, clean committed source, installed artifact identity, all required local/live evidence, accurate Taskbot state, no unresolved blockers.
requirements.required_evidence: Final gate names incomplete external authority/evidence; no scaffold/mock/draft/queued success substitution.

planning_only_references.purpose: Observed failures motivate tests; historical observations are not current verified capabilities.
External research is design evidence, not implementation acceptance.

ticket_mapping_policy: Each requirement has an accountable concrete implementation, qualification or final-review ticket; related_tickets identify later integration/evidence responsibility without implying completed verification.

freeze_requires: Real independent bounded defects confirmed against exact Attraccess source; no fabricated eligibility or inherited repaired branches.
For each task freeze issue/spec, base SHA, check plan, scope, exclusions, fixtures/scenarios, models, budgets, delivery mode and authority.
Record all attempts and admission rejections; reruns do not replace failures; no-code conclusions do not count.
Record completion/interventions excluding planned approval, failure signatures, environment failures, elapsed/model/cost and missing artifacts.
No retroactive eligibility exclusions or acceptance weakening.

explicit_deferrals: Flow editor, user-defined nodes and public workflow SDK
Multiple harnesses and high concurrent implementation
Large dashboard and firmware benchmark tasks pending decomposition and fixture/device readiness

authority_blockers.scope: Isolated Attraccess setup outside authorized Rocky worktree
Attraccess target-source mutation and remote draft/CI/Linear test effects
Protected merge requires exact-revision human approval
